latest_release.name: GitHub MCP Server 2.1.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* build(deps-dev): bump @types/node from 26.6.4 to 26.6.5 in /ui by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3516
* docs: fix broken MCP SDKs link in host-integration.md by @muba76ma in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3598
* build(deps): bump @primer/octicons-react from 19.38.0 to 19.40.0 in /ui by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3515
* build(deps-dev): bump vite-plugin-singlefile from 2.3.3 to 2.3.4 in /ui by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3551
* build(deps): bump golang.org/x/net from 0.59.0 to 0.61.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3509
* build(deps): bump github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 from 5.3.2 to 5.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3508
* build(deps): bump github/codeql-action/start-proxy from 4.38.2 to 4.39.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3553
* Fix merged state in pull request list output by @po-et in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3468
* Add two experimental MCP tools to create, read, update, and delete artifacts attached  by @veralizeth in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3554
* fix: reject integer parameters at or above 2^63 by @JoannaaKL in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3650
* Replace retired GitHub Models triage with agentic workflows by @JoannaaKL in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3629

## New Contributors
* @muba76ma made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3598
* @po-et made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3468

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/compare/v2.0.3...v2.1.0
